related.description: ZSH plugin to automatically (de)activate Python virtual environments.
🐍 ZSH plugin to automatically switch python virtualenvs (including pipenv and poetry) as you move between directories
🐚 Simple ZSH plugin for automatically activating and deactivating Poetry-created virtualenvs. 🐍
A simple zsh plugin that automatically activates VS Code shell integration when working in VS Code terminals.
Plugin provides condaenv_prompt_info which can be used in a theme
